summary.zh: 把每个人只看到的一小段事实，变成一次全体承担后果的决定。
summary.en: Turn partial individual observations into a decision whose consequences affect the group.

rules.zh: 事件触发讨论阶段，玩家依次陈述见闻、质疑矛盾，再投票决定怀疑对象或暂不行动。投票结果改变参与者或局势，余下玩家据此重新判断旧证词。
rules.en: An event opens discussion: players share observations, challenge inconsistencies and vote on a suspect or defer action. The outcome changes the group and gives remaining players a reason to reassess earlier claims.

decisions.zh: 证据不足时跟随多数，还是保留意见并解释原因？
decisions.en: Follow the majority with weak evidence or explain why you disagree?

decisions.zh: 先说最可疑的人，还是先报能被别人核对的时间地点？
decisions.en: Name a suspect first or give a checkable time and place?

effect.zh: 太短只能抢话，太长容易重复；应容纳一轮陈述和追问。
effect.en: Too short rewards interruption; too long invites repetition. Allow an account and a follow-up.

effect.zh: 公开身份让推理快速校正，隐藏身份让后续判断更不确定。
effect.en: Revealed roles provide quick correction; concealed roles preserve uncertainty.

contrast.zh: 共同点是把私人见闻汇成集体决定；角色种类越多，讨论越需要区分“看到了什么”和“推测是什么”。
contrast.en: Both convert private observations into group action; larger role sets make separating observation from interpretation especially useful.

combination.zh: 设计提案：每人拿到案发现场的一角，先讨论再表决打开哪个证据箱，错误决定会消耗一次调查机会。
combination.en: Design proposal: give each player a fragment of a crime scene and vote on which evidence box to open, spending an investigation chance on mistakes.

setup.zh: 编辑示例：四人中一人弄坏机器，A看到B离开机房，C看到D拿着工具。
setup.en: Editorial example: one of four people broke a machine. A saw B leave the room; C saw D carrying tools.

action.zh: 大家先确认先后顺序，发现D拿工具是在警报之后，于是把票投给B。
action.en: They establish the order of events: D fetched tools after the alarm, so they vote for B.

result.zh: B的身份揭晓，大家知道哪些推断可靠、哪些证词可能误导。
result.en: B’s role is revealed, showing which inferences held and which accounts may mislead.

next.zh: 下一轮保留已确认的事实，再讨论新事件。
next.en: Carry verified facts into the next incident rather than restarting the argument.

firstStep.zh: 用四份不同证词、一个限时讨论和纸面投票，做三轮短案情。
firstStep.en: Run three short cases with four different accounts, timed discussion and paper ballots.

pitfall.zh: 先让证据能改变投票；复杂发言权限、实时语音与房间匹配会掩盖基础讨论是否成立。
pitfall.en: First ensure evidence changes votes; elaborate speaking rules, voice chat and matchmaking can hide a weak discussion loop.

test.zh: 至少有一名试玩者因新证据改变原投票，并能说明是哪条信息改变了判断。
test.en: At least one tester changes a vote because of new evidence and can name the evidence.
